title: Uniqueness Characterization of Fibonacci-Sum Permutations (Layman's Conjecture / Hajnal Conjecture 1)
description: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization proving that, for every integer k >= 1, there is exactly one permutation p of {1, ..., k} with every i + p(i) a Fibonacci number if and only if k = w(n) for some n >= 1 (equivalently, k = M4(l) for some l >= 2), where Layman's sequence is w(n) = floor(F_{n+3} / sqrt(5)) for n >= 1. Formalizes Hajnal's (2022) "only if" direction and Reshetnikov's (2015, OEIS A097083) floor formula alongside a step-lemma proof of the "if" direction (Hajnal Conjecture 1). Companion write-up and dated prior-work searches (arXiv, OEIS, zbMATH, CORE 2026-11-20, Google Scholar 2026-11-22) are published at https://mathdiscoveries.org/results/fibonacci-sum-permutations; the "if" direction was not found in those logged searches (MathSciNet and print problem sections remain unsearched). Generated and checked by AI research agents built and directed by Tyler B. Hughes. No human mathematician has yet refereed the proof.
